note: A fee charged for processing a transaction or service; the amount and conditions depend on the provider.

senses.m: A fee charged for processing a transaction or service
senses.pat: pay a handling charge · a small handling charge · handling-charge fee
ex: The seller added a handling charge to the order.
Người bán cộng phí xử lý vào đơn hàng.
There is no handling charge for online payment.
Không có phí xử lý khi thanh toán trực tuyến.

note: The central, most committed part of a group; also the toughest central part of an object. As an adjective, hardcore can mean extreme or highly committed and is usually one word.

senses.m: The central, most committed part of a group
senses.pat: the hard core of supporters · a hard-core group · hardcore music
ex: A hard core of volunteers kept the project running.
Một nhóm nòng cốt tình nguyện viên duy trì dự án.
The documentary follows hardcore fans of the band.
Phim tài liệu theo chân những người hâm mộ cuồng nhiệt của ban nhạc.

note: A broad term for conditions affecting the heart, including coronary artery disease and heart rhythm disorders; the exact condition should be named when known.

senses.m: A broad term for conditions affecting the heart, including coronary artery disease and heart rhythm disorders
senses.pat: risk of heart disease · diagnose/treat heart disease · heart-disease prevention
ex: Smoking increases the risk of heart disease.
Hút thuốc làm tăng nguy cơ mắc bệnh tim.
The clinic offers screening for heart disease.
Phòng khám cung cấp dịch vụ tầm soát bệnh tim.

note: A condition in which the heart cannot pump blood sufficiently for the body’s needs; it is not the same as the heart suddenly stopping. Medical assessment is required.

senses.m: A condition in which the heart cannot pump blood sufficiently for the body’s needs
senses.pat: develop heart failure · chronic heart failure · symptoms of heart failure
ex: The patient was treated for heart failure.
Bệnh nhân được điều trị suy tim.
The specialist explained how heart failure affects daily activity.
Bác sĩ chuyên khoa giải thích suy tim ảnh hưởng đến sinh hoạt hằng ngày ra sao.

note: The number of heartbeats per minute; normal ranges vary with age, activity, health, and medications.

senses.m: The number of heartbeats per minute
senses.pat: measure/check heart rate · resting heart rate · heart-rate monitor
ex: The watch recorded her heart rate during the run.
Đồng hồ ghi lại nhịp tim của cô trong lúc chạy.
His heart rate slowed after he sat down to rest.
Nhịp tim của anh chậm lại sau khi ngồi nghỉ.

note: A medical device that temporarily takes over heart and lung functions during certain operations; also called a cardiopulmonary bypass machine.

senses.m: A medical device that temporarily takes over heart and lung functions during certain operations
senses.pat: use a heart-lung machine · operate on a heart-lung machine · heart-lung bypass
ex: The surgical team connected the patient to a heart-lung machine.
Đội phẫu thuật nối bệnh nhân với máy tim phổi nhân tạo.
The machine circulated blood while the surgeon operated.
Máy tuần hoàn máu trong khi bác sĩ phẫu thuật.

note: A period of unusually hot weather, often lasting several days; official thresholds vary by region and climate.

senses.m: A period of unusually hot weather, often lasting several days
senses.pat: a prolonged heat wave · heat-wave warning · cope with a heat wave
ex: The heat wave pushed temperatures above 40 degrees.
Đợt nắng nóng khiến nhiệt độ vượt quá 40 độ.
The city opened cooling centers during the heat wave.
Thành phố mở các điểm tránh nóng trong đợt nắng nóng.

note: Excessive admiration of a person, treating them as a hero; can imply uncritical devotion.

senses.m: Excessive admiration of a person, treating them as a hero
senses.pat: show hero worship · an object of hero worship · discourage hero worship
ex: The biography avoids hero worship and discusses his failures too.
Cuốn tiểu sử tránh thần tượng hóa và cũng bàn về những thất bại của ông.
Some fans’ hero worship made criticism difficult.
Sự tôn sùng thần tượng của một số người hâm mộ khiến việc phê bình trở nên khó khăn.

note: The main diplomatic mission of one Commonwealth country in another, headed by a high commissioner; also the office or building.

senses.m: The main diplomatic mission of one Commonwealth country in another, headed by a high commissioner
senses.pat: the High Commission in · contact the High Commission · high-commission staff
ex: She applied for a visa at the High Commission.
Cô nộp đơn xin thị thực tại Cao ủy.
The High Commission issued a travel advisory.
Cao ủy ban hành khuyến cáo du lịch.

note: Advanced technology or products using it; usually written high-tech as an adjective and high tech as a noun.

senses.m: Advanced technology or products using it
senses.pat: high-tech equipment · a high-tech industry · invest in high tech
ex: The lab uses high-tech imaging equipment.
Phòng thí nghiệm sử dụng thiết bị chẩn đoán hình ảnh công nghệ cao.
The region is attracting high-tech companies.
Khu vực đang thu hút các công ty công nghệ cao.

note: Education after secondary school, especially at universities and colleges; structure and terminology differ by country.

senses.m: Education after secondary school, especially at universities and colleges
senses.pat: access to higher education · higher-education institutions · pursue higher education
ex: She works in higher education policy.
Cô làm về chính sách giáo dục đại học.
The scholarship expands access to higher education.
Học bổng mở rộng cơ hội tiếp cận giáo dục sau trung học.

note: Official rules and advice for road users, especially in Britain; the corresponding manual and rules differ by country.

senses.m: Official rules and advice for road users, especially in Britain
senses.pat: follow the Highway Code · consult the highway code · highway-code rules
ex: Cyclists must follow the Highway Code.
Người đi xe đạp phải tuân thủ Bộ luật Giao thông đường bộ.
He studied the highway code before taking the test.
Anh học quy tắc giao thông trước khi thi.

note: The joint where the thigh bone meets the pelvis; it supports movement and weight-bearing.

senses.m: The joint where the thigh bone meets the pelvis
senses.pat: pain in the hip joint · replace a hip joint · hip-joint movement
ex: The scan showed inflammation in the hip joint.
Ảnh chụp cho thấy khớp háng bị viêm.
The exercise improves mobility around the hip joint.
Bài tập cải thiện khả năng vận động quanh khớp háng.

note: A pocket at the side or back of trousers near the hip; figuratively, immediate personal control or resources in a phrase like in someone’s hip pocket.

senses.m: A pocket at the side or back of trousers near the hip
senses.pat: put something in a hip pocket · a hip-pocket notebook · keep cash in the hip pocket
ex: He kept the folded map in his hip pocket.
Anh để tấm bản đồ gấp trong túi quần sau.
The lobbyist was accused of keeping the official in his hip pocket.
Nhà vận động hành lang bị cáo buộc thao túng vị quan chức.

note: A worker employed to do manual or farm work; often informal and sometimes dated.

senses.m: A worker employed to do manual or farm work
senses.pat: hire a hired hand · work as a hired hand · a ranch hired hand
ex: The ranch hired a hand for the busy season.
Trang trại thuê một lao động thời vụ cho mùa bận rộn.
He started as a hired hand and later ran the farm.
Anh bắt đầu là lao động làm thuê rồi sau này điều hành trang trại.

note: A published list of people receiving honors or awards, especially a British royal honours list; US spelling is honors list.

senses.m: A published list of people receiving honors or awards, especially a British royal honours list
senses.pat: appear on the honours list · publish an honours list · New Year honours list
ex: Her name appeared on the New Year honours list.
Tên bà xuất hiện trong danh sách vinh danh đầu năm mới.
The honours list recognized volunteers across the country.
Danh sách vinh danh ghi nhận các tình nguyện viên trên khắp đất nước.

note: A small metal fastener consisting of a hook and a loop, used on clothes or fabric; also hook-and-eye.

senses.m: A small metal fastener consisting of a hook and a loop, used on clothes or fabric
senses.pat: fasten a hook and eye · sew on a hook-and-eye closure · hook-and-eye fastener
ex: She repaired the skirt with a hook and eye.
Cô sửa váy bằng móc cài và khoen.
The dress has a hook-and-eye closure at the back.
Chiếc váy có khóa móc và khoen phía sau.

note: A one-handed basketball shot made with the shooter’s body between the ball and defender, often released in a sweeping arc.

senses.m: A one-handed basketball shot made with the shooter’s body between the ball and defender, often released in a sweeping arc
senses.pat: make/attempt a hook shot · a one-handed hook shot · score with a hook shot
ex: The center scored with a hook shot over the defender.
Trung phong ghi điểm bằng cú ném móc qua người phòng thủ.
She practiced the hook shot from both sides of the basket.
Cô luyện cú ném móc ở cả hai bên rổ.

note: A difficult or controversial issue people want to avoid dealing with; literal hot potato is food too hot to hold.

senses.m: A difficult or controversial issue people want to avoid dealing with
senses.pat: a political hot potato · pass the hot potato to · become a hot potato
ex: The funding plan became a political hot potato.
Kế hoạch tài trợ trở thành vấn đề chính trị nóng bỏng.
Neither department wanted to take responsibility for the hot potato.
Không phòng ban nào muốn nhận trách nhiệm về vấn đề khó xử đó.

note: A very small bird that can hover and feed on nectar; normally spelled hummingbird as one word.

senses.m: A very small bird that can hover and feed on nectar
senses.pat: a hummingbird hovers · hummingbird feeder · watch a hummingbird feed
ex: A hummingbird hovered beside the red flowers.
Một con chim ruồi lơ lửng bên những bông hoa đỏ.
They hung a hummingbird feeder near the window.
Họ treo máng ăn cho chim ruồi gần cửa sổ.
